Name: Furniture Recolor
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod lets you tint individual furniture pieces and wall-hangings using R, G, and B hotkeys.

To tint a piece of furniture, hover over it with the mouse, then press (and hold) one of the hotkeys to increase the red, green, or blue tint of an object.

Default hotkeys are:

[list]
[*]Red: [b]NumPad 1[/b]
[*]Green: [b]Num Pad 7[/b]
[*]Blue: [b]Num Pad 9[/b]
[*]Reset tint: [b]Num Pad 3[/b]
[/list]
If you hold down a mod key (default [b]Left Alt[/b]), it decreases the respective tint instead.

Furniture recolor is tied to the furniture's placement, so moving or removing furniture pieces resets their tint.


You can edit all the config variables using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿, or editing the [b]config.json[/b] file.

See also [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10213]Furniture Adjustment[/url] for shifting placement of individual furniture pieces.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires SDV 1.5.5+

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.
